title: A Child's Shoe With My Name In It

scenes.text: A CHILD'S SHOE. MY NAME IN IT.
scenes.narration: Somebody handed in a child's shoe today. My name is written inside it, in my mother's handwriting.
scenes.imagePrompt: A single small child's leather sandal on a wooden counter, a brown luggage tag tied to its strap on string, lit by a single bulb, no people, photographed on grainy 35mm film under a single bare tungsten bulb, the whole frame colour-graded warm amber like sodium light with no grey or blue cast, heavy analog grain

scenes.narration: I lost that shoe when I was six, on a beach. My mother walked the tideline for an hour looking for it.
scenes.imagePrompt: An empty pebble beach at dusk, the tideline marked with dark seaweed, a single tiny footprint in wet sand, no people, photographed on grainy 35mm film under a single bare tungsten bulb, the whole frame colour-graded warm amber like sodium light with no grey or blue cast, heavy analog grain

scenes.narration: There is still sand in it. It is wet. I tipped it out on the counter, and it smells of the sea.
scenes.imagePrompt: A small heap of wet sand tipped out across a wooden counter, a child's sandal lying on its side beside it, no people, photographed on grainy 35mm film under a single bare tungsten bulb, the whole frame colour-graded warm amber like sodium light with no grey or blue cast, heavy analog grain

scenes.narration: The tag says found on the fourth floor, like everything else. I wonder how long it lay there before somebody picked it up.
scenes.imagePrompt: A child's sandal on an otherwise empty steel shelf in a wire mesh cage, its brown tag hanging down over the edge, no people, photographed on grainy 35mm film under a single bare tungsten bulb, the whole frame colour-graded warm amber like sodium light with no grey or blue cast, heavy analog grain
